36: pub fn decoding_key_from_secret(

39: ) -> JWTResult<DecodingKey<'static>> {
40:     match alg {
41:         Algorithm::HS256 | Algorithm::HS384 | Algorithm::HS512 => {
42:             if secret_string.starts_with('@') {
43:                 let secret = slurp_file(&secret_string.chars().skip(1).collect::<String>());

45:             } else if secret_string.starts_with("b64:") {

47:                     &base64_engine
48:                         .decode(secret_string.chars().skip(4).collect::<String>())
49:                         .unwrap(),
50:                 )
51:                 .into_static())
52:             } else {
53:                 Ok(DecodingKey::from_secret(secret_string.as_bytes()).into_static())
54:             }
55:         }
56:         Algorithm::RS256
57:         | Algorithm::RS384
58:         | Algorithm::RS512
59:         | Algorithm::PS256
60:         | Algorithm::PS384
61:         | Algorithm::PS512 => {
62:             let secret = slurp_file(&secret_string.chars().skip(1).collect::<String>());

119:         token
120:     });

126:         },

153:                 bunt::eprintln!("{$red+bold}The secret provided isn't a valid ECDSA key{/$}")

156:                 bunt::eprintln!("{$red+bold}The token has expired (or the `exp` claim is not set). This error can be ignored via the `--ignore-exp` parameter.{/$}")

159:                 bunt::println!("{$red+bold}The token issuer is invalid{/$}")

165:                 bunt::eprintln!("{$red+bold}The token subject doesn't match the audience{/$}")
166:             }

168:                 "{$red+bold}The `nbf` claim is in the future which isn't allowed{/$}"
169:             ),
170:             ErrorKind::InvalidAlgorithm => bunt::eprintln!(
171:                 "{$red+bold}The JWT provided has a different signing algorithm than the one you \
172: 									 provided{/$}",
173:             ),
174:             _ => bunt::eprintln!(
175:                 "{$red+bold}The JWT provided is invalid because{/$} {:?}",
176:                 err
177:             ),
178:         };
179:     }

181:     match (format, token_data) {

**Considering upgrade needs**

I’m thinking about the necessary upgrades for the jsonwebtoken package. With version 8, it looks like changes include the removal of lifetime in DecodingKey and the renaming of dangerous_insecure_decode.
